arabic text: PARH NAD-E-ALI ZAINAB AKHAY MERI KAR BABA\nIMDAAD AY
english translation text: ‘Recite Nad-e-Ali,’ Zainab cries, ‘Father,\ncome to my aid.’

arabic text: MAIN TALIYAN MALDI REHGAIYYAN - HAYE BOLDA NAYI\nSAJJAD AY
english translation text: I can only wring my hands—alas,\nSajjad does not respond.

arabic text:
ESS WASTAY KAMAR JHUKA TURDA - MERA ISTAQBAL
NAI SEH SAKEYA,
JISS VAYLAY DI CHADAR UTRI - AY KADAM KADAM TAY
KATAL HOYA,
TERI NASAL DA WARIS GIRGAYA AY - ENNU AAKHAY
HOSH KARADAY
english translation text:
He walks bent over because he could not bear
to come forward and receive me.
From the moment my veil was taken, he has died
a death at every step.
The heir of your lineage has fallen—tell him
to regain consciousness.

arabic text:
SUN HOKAY BABA UJRI DAY - KHAIBAR NU CHAANA
SOKHA AY,
ZAINAB DAY NAL SHARAABI DAY - DARBAR CH JAANA
OKHA AY,
HARR ZULAM NU JAYRA SEHGAYA AY - BASS 'O'
MAZLOOM SAJJAD AY
english translation text:
Listen, Father: for one who has been plundered,
lifting Khaybar is easy;
but entering a drunkard’s court beside Zainab
is difficult.
The one who has endured every cruelty
is this oppressed Sajjad.

arabic text:
NAI LASH HUSSAIN TAY ROUWN DITTA - MAIN FEYR VI
BABA CHUP RAIYYAN,
KAYI BAAR BACHAYA ABID NU - KHUD AAP ME SAINDI
DHUK RAIYYAN,
BAZAR ABOOR MAIN KAR AIYYAN - DARBAR ABOOR
KARADEY
english translation text:
They did not let me weep over Hussain’s body,
yet even then, Father, I remained silent.
Many times I saved Abid,
enduring the pain upon myself.
I have crossed the marketplace—
now help me cross the court.

arabic text:
KARBAL TOUN LEHKAY SHAAM TAYEIN - JAYRI ROUNDI
RAYI DIN RAIN AY,
KEETA HAMLA FER YAZEEDIYAN NAY - NAI QABAR DAY
WICH VI CHAIN AY,
DO JAG DA WARIS AY MOLA - ZAINAB DA HARAM
BACHADAY
english translation text:
From Karbala all the way to Shaam,
she wept day and night.
The Yazidis attacked her again;
even in the grave she has no peace.
O Master of both worlds,
protect Zainab’s sanctuary.

arabic text:
METHO PUCH BABA SIRR GHAZI DA - KYON NAYZEY TAY
NAYI ANDA AY,
SIRR NANGA VEKH KAY ZAINAB DA - ABBAS DA SIR GIR
JANDA AY,
BARDAASHT NA GHAZI KARSAKEYA - KHULEY VAAL AY
DHEE ZAHRA DAY
english translation text:
Ask me, Father, why Ghazi’s head
does not appear upon a spear.
Whenever he saw Zainab bareheaded,
Abbas’s head would fall.
Ghazi could not bear to see
Zahra’s daughter with her hair uncovered.

arabic text:
TERAY PUTAR ABBAS DI CHUP BABA - MENU SHAAM
DAY WICH LEH AYI AY,
FARIYAD HASSAN AY KARDI SI - SIR NANGAY ZAHRA
JAYI AY,
IK CHADAR NAJAF TO LEH-AA TU - UJRI DAY SIRR TAY
PADAY
english translation text:
Father, the silence of your son Abbas
has brought me into Shaam.
Hasan cried out in anguish:
‘Zahra’s daughter is bareheaded.’
Bring a veil from Najaf
and place it upon the plundered one’s head.
